765000101.text: #{NICKNAME}! Over here! Paimon's got something awesome to show you!

765000102.text: Ta-da! Look at this! It took Paimon forever to dig up this treasure from that bustling market!

765000106.text: According to the mysterious shopkeeper, this was the Kamera used by that super famous Fontainian photographer from a few decades ago: the legendary Pierre Leblanc!

765000107.text: Rumor has it that the photos he took with this Kamera were all smash hits, and they'd often make it onto the front page of The Steambird!

765000108.text: If you use this legendary Kamera, your photos will be like... doubly legendary! And then we can sell them for Mora!

765000105.text: No, silly! This is a surprise gift Paimon prepared just for you!
